lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for most change types (choose_path redesign, finish new_flow, finish notification, home new_flow, home new_screen, sign_in hint, sign_in reorder) as each has only been tested once.
With 2 tests completed for adoption copy changes, results do not yet agree (one won at +4.5% after noise correction, while the other had no clear effect at -0.3%), so evidence remains thin.
No clear effect was seen for home new_flow, home new_screen, finish notification, finish new_flow, sign_in hint, or choose_path redesign changes.
Reordering sign-in performed poorly (-5.2% after noise correction) and was stopped early, but evidence is still thin to form a definitive rule.

Predictions were not consistently too high across all tests: while most tests overestimated impact, predictions underestimated the winning adoption copy change (predicted +0.5% vs +4.5% after noise correction).

lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for almost all change kinds (such as home wait_info, sign_in reorder, and finish redesign) because each has only been tested once.
With 2 tests completed for adoption copy changes, results do not agree (one won at +4.5% after noise correction, while the other showed no clear effect at -0.3%), so evidence remains thin.
No clear effect was observed for most tested changes, including tests that leaned positive like sign_in hint (+2.4%) or home new_flow (+2.1%).
Predictions consistently overestimated the impact of non-winning tests, especially in early rounds where large positive effects were expected.

Predictions underestimated the impact of both winning tests (upload_photos_error_prevention_copy predicted +0.5% vs +4.5% after noise correction; waiting_desktop_render_checklist predicted +2.0% vs +3.6% after noise correction).
